name: COBOL Migration with Neo4j & Enhanced Portal

5028.label: Migration Portal (Enhanced UI with Reports & Mermaid)

postCreateCommand:
npm install -g @github/copilot@latest && dotnet restore Legacy-Modernization-Agents.sln && dotnet build Legacy-Modernization-Agents.sln && echo '
✅ Dev Container Ready!

Quick Start:
  ./doctor.sh setup
  ./doctor.sh run
  Portal: http://localhost:5028
  Neo4j: http://localhost:7474
'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock && if [ -f Config/ai-config.local.env ]; then export NEO4J_PASSWORD="$(sed -n "s/^NEO4J_PASSWORD=//p" Config/ai-config.local.env | tail -1 | tr -d "\"")" && export ApplicationSettings__Neo4j__Password="$NEO4J_PASSWORD" && docker-compose up -d neo4j && echo "Starting services..." && sleep 3 && cd McpChatWeb && nohup dotnet run --urls "http://localhost:5028" > /tmp/cobol-portal.log 2>&1 & echo "Portal starting on http://localhost:5028"; else echo "Run ./doctor.sh setup before starting services"; fi'
